reviews.title: Disappointing: No link between Vision Board and goal
reviews.text:
I paid $19.99 for a one year subscription.

I expected it to work and have some functionality.

I created about Vision Board and a few goals. I used the app to link the goals to the Vision. Unfortunately, it will not link them. When you look at the Vision Board, there is no indication that has any goals attached.

I am going to request a refund.

For now, I will continue using a spreadsheet to track goals.

reviews.title: Good - Maybe great one day
reviews.text: The basic functionality of the app is solid. Could possibly use some work around how you input and track daily, monthly & annual goals. The ability to “paste” into the mood boards would be great. Additionally, embedded search functionality to find mood board photos would be awesome too (allows us to stay in the app). But my absolute biggest compliant, and possibly the easiest fix, is horrible options you offer for backgrounds when customizing. Most could be viewed as feminine in appearance and overall feel. Not all users want that look. Give us neutrals and some more masculine feeling options. And/or let us use our own photos for the widget backgrounds. I’m sure there are many men and women that don’t want a pink heart as a background. Please fix.

reviews.title: My Vision Boards Keep Disappearing
reviews.text: For the most part I enjoyed using the app. It would have been better if it was possible to reposition items without completely deleting them first; maybe in another iteration. My only issue is that after a few months my vision boards completely disappeared. I was left with a prompt to create my FIRST BOARD! Thankfully, I had taken pictures of my boards each time I created them. After all the effort to find the images I wanted to use and the time invested to create my boards, it was very disappointing to have them just disappear. I’ve chosen to just delete the app. At least I have screenshots of my boards.
